svg.title: 124M cells in 611 GB
svg.desc: Same annotated corpus: 622 datasets, 123868479 cells, 2654 matrices. H5CP is the sum of actual full-file sizes. Uncompressed H5AD = matrix data + CSR indices + CSR indptr + the same nonmatrix bytes. SciPy defaults select int32/int64 jointly for indices and indptr; matrices with nnz above 2^31-1 require int64. Compact H5AD uses uint16/uint32 column indices while retaining SciPy-selected indptr. Values retain source dtypes. H5AD accounting excludes matrix-dataset HDF5 object headers/chunk indices; these H5AD files were not written in full. Counts matrix size is part of H5CP total and does not include other matrices or annotations. All GB/TB units are decimal.

text.font-family: 'CP Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

g.text: The same 124M-cell corpus as AnnData H5AD and as CellPack H5CP
